name: tsuzuki
description: 続き — local-first watch history, resume points and search history. Nothing leaves your devices unencrypted.

scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@10 build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build:firefox && git archive --format=zip -o dist/tsuzuki-source.zip HEAD && npx --yes web-ext@10 sign --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts --channel unlisted --upload-source-code dist/tsuzuki-source.zip
